title: Item 1 · Black Belt money in Finance — planned, not built yet
subtitle: Not a defect: this is planned work. Finance decided on Oct 19 (rulebook v0.808) to add Black Belt payments to the Daily report “once Black Belt payments exist” — it's in Finance's status file (§8, “Later: Black Belt payments”) and Black Belt's. Black Belt's payments went live Oct 21, so until Finance's step is built, a Black Belt payment taken at the desk won't show in that day's report. (Preview screenshots with the fake database · pretend date Mon, Apr 26, 2027 · Shrewsbury)

columns.label: Today, until Finance's step is built

items.caption: 1. At the desk, Bao Nguyen pays his $500 Black Belt payment in cash. The roster takes it: “Payment recorded · $500 · Bao Nguyen”.
2. The same day in Finance: Total $15.00, Cash $0.00. Only a $15 camp card payment is listed. The $500 isn't there.
3. At closing, staff count $500 in the drawer. The dashboard expected $0.00, says “Over $500.00”, and makes them type a note explaining money it should already know about.

columns.note: The payment is saved in Black Belt. It just doesn't reach Finance yet: not the Daily report, not History, not Close the day, not the CSV for the bookkeeper.

columns.label: When it's built (mockup of rule v0.808)

items.caption: 4. The payment shows in Finance as “Black Belt · Spring 2027 · Payment 2”, on the day it was taken, and the Total and Cash cards include it.
5. At closing, the $500 counted matches what Finance expects. Nothing to explain.

columns.note: Already decided. Rulebook v0.808 (Oct 19): the line “Black Belt · cycle · what it's for”, counted on the day it was taken; v0.809: a bounced check gets its own “Returned checks” group. Pictures 4 and 5 are drawn over the real page; nothing in the app was changed.

footer: Owner: Finance (one database migration, listed in its status file §8). Decision: none needed — it's planned. Noted for the end of the walkthrough: Black Belt's payment screens went live before Finance reads them, so a Black Belt payment taken before Finance's step is built makes that day's count look over by the same amount. Tablet and phone: same screens, only the numbers change.
